oc_institute.title: Oncoclínicas Institute
oc_institute.subtitle: Education, research, and continuing education
oc_institute.mission_text: Founded in 2015, the Oncoclínicas Institute has the mission of generating, disseminating, and integrating knowledge, qualifying professionals involved in cancer treatment, and providing an environment that promotes interdisciplinarity.
oc_institute.partnership_text: We have a partnership with the Dana Farber Cancer Institute / Harvard Medical School, which reinforces our commitment to continuously pursuing the best clinical practices, with this American institution being one of the world’s leading references in cancer treatment.
oc_institute.oc_academy_description: Access the platform and explore educational content created by the best specialists
